_comment: VaporKey factory presets. Edit this file to add/remove/tweak presets.
It is embedded into the plugin binary at build time via juce_add_binary_data,
and parsed lazily on first access (see Presets.cpp).
Each preset has:
name     - display string
category - one of: Bass, Lead, Pad, Pluck, Keys, Bell, FX, Arp
values   - object of paramID -> value (any param not listed keeps its default)
Wavetable shape indices for osc<n>_shape:
0 Basic, 1 Saws, 2 Squares, 3 Vocal, 4 Bell, 5 Digital, 6 Harmonic, 7 Glass, 8 Reso, 9 Custom (per-osc user .wav)
10 Sync, 11 RingMod, 12 Wavefold, 13 Vowels, 14 Choir, 15 Whisper,
16 Organ, 17 Pluck, 18 Sawteeth, 19 Even/Odd, 20 Tine, 21 Mallet,
22 FM Stack, 23 Bitcrush
Mod destinations for macro<m>_dest, mw_dest, at_dest:
0 Off, 1 Cutoff, 2 Resonance, 3-5 Osc1-3 Pos, 6-8 Osc1-3 Lvl,
9-11 Osc1-3 Det, 12 LFO1 Rate, 13 LFO2 Rate, 14 Delay Mix, 15 Reverb Mix,
16 Chorus Mix, 17 Phaser Mix, 18 Dist Drive, 19 Width
Sync divisions (lfo<n>_div, delay_div, arp_div):
Cross-osc modulation (osc<n>_mod_*):
mod_src: 0 Off, 1 Osc1, 2 Osc2, 3 Osc3 (self-routing is silently ignored)
mod_type: 0 FM, 1 Ring, 2 AM
mod_amt: 0..1 depth
